title: External Network Penetration Test — Harborview Credit Union (Q2)
summary: Assessed internet-facing perimeter. Exposed VPN portal and outdated Exchange components; no evidence of domain compromise.
recommendations: Restrict VPN portal by geo/IP allowlist and enforce MFA for all accounts
Patch and harden OWA/Exchange; remove legacy TLS ciphers
Implement continuous external attack surface monitoring for new hosts

title: Web Application Security Assessment — Customer Portal
summary: Reviewed auth, session handling, and common OWASP classes. Found stored XSS in shipment notes and weak rate limits on login.
recommendations: Encode/normalize user-supplied shipment notes; add CSP with strict-dynamic
Add login throttling and account lockout with user-friendly recovery
Centralize input validation and add security unit tests for templates

title: Wireless Security Review — Guest and Staff SSIDs
summary: Validated WPA2-Enterprise configuration on staff network; guest network segmentation gaps allowed limited lateral access to printers.
recommendations: Move guest VLAN to isolated firewall zone; block east-west by default
Disable WPS and rotate shared secrets on guest captive portal
Enable 802.11w PMF on supported APs and standardize AP firmware

title: Internal Vulnerability Assessment — Corp VLANs
summary: Scanned 1,142 hosts across corp subnets. Highest risk issues were SMB signing disabled and multiple unpatched Windows Server 2016 systems.
recommendations: Enable SMB signing and disable SMBv1 across all endpoints
Accelerate patch cadence for servers; prioritize exposed management interfaces
Deploy LAPS and remove local admin reuse across workstations

title: API Security Assessment — Public REST v2
summary: Tested authZ, object-level access, and input handling. Found IDOR on invoice endpoints and excessive error detail in 500 responses.
recommendations: Implement per-resource authorization checks; add regression tests for IDOR
Standardize error handling; strip stack traces and internal IDs from API responses
Add schema validation and request size limits at the gateway

title: External Attack Surface Review — Domains and Cloud
summary: Enumerated DNS, cert transparency, and cloud endpoints. Detected stale Azure subdomain pointing to deprovisioned app service (takeover risk).
recommendations: Remove or claim orphaned Azure App Service DNS entries immediately
Enable domain monitoring for new certs and unknown subdomains
Harden SPF/DKIM/DMARC and quarantine unauthenticated mail

title: Phishing Readiness Exercise — Spring Campaign
summary: Simulated credential-harvest and attachment lures across 1,980 staff. Click-through was moderate; reporting rate improved vs prior quarter.
recommendations: Expand targeted training for departments with highest click rate
Enable FIDO2/WebAuthn for admin and finance roles
Tune mail gateway to flag lookalike domains and QR code lures

title: Cloud Configuration Review — AWS Landing Zone
summary: Reviewed IAM, S3, CloudTrail, and VPC guardrails. Two S3 buckets allowed public list; CloudTrail not multi-region in one account.
recommendations: Block public access at account level and enforce SCPs for S3 policies
Enable multi-region CloudTrail and centralize logs to immutable storage
Reduce IAM wildcard permissions and require MFA for console access

title: Tenant Portal Assessment — Auth & Data Exposure
summary: Validated account flows and data segregation. Found insecure direct object reference on maintenance ticket attachments for inactive tenants.
recommendations: Enforce ownership checks on all attachment downloads; log access attempts
Expire session tokens on password change and enable device-bound refresh tokens
Add DAST to CI for critical flows (login, attachments, admin)

title: OT/ICS Perimeter Review — Plant 3
summary: Reviewed firewall rules and exposed services around PLC networks. Identified remote access jump host with weak MFA policy and broad rules.
recommendations: Restrict jump host access with conditional access + phishing-resistant MFA
Segment PLC networks with allowlisted protocols only
Inventory vendor remote tools and enforce time-bound access approvals

title: Red Team Lite — Initial Access to Impact
summary: Emulated realistic intrusion. Achieved initial access via exposed dev Jenkins and pivoted to internal file shares; no prod DB access obtained.
recommendations: Lock down CI/CD endpoints; require SSO + MFA and restrict by IP
Rotate secrets and migrate hardcoded tokens to a vault
Enable EDR tamper protection and centralize alert triage

title: HIPAA Technical Safeguards Check — Clinic Systems
summary: Focused on access controls, audit logging, and device security. Noted inconsistent workstation auto-lock and limited audit log retention.
recommendations: Enforce 5-minute screen lock via GPO/MDM across all endpoints
Increase audit log retention to 180+ days and monitor privileged actions
Harden RDP exposure and require VPN with MFA for remote staff

title: External Vulnerability Scan Summary — Monthly
recommendations: Maintain weekly patching for perimeter devices; track exceptions in a risk register
Enable authenticated scanning for server fleets to reduce false negatives

title: PCI ASV Prep — E-commerce and Payment Flows
summary: Validated scope and ran discovery against storefront and payment integrations. Found outdated OpenSSL on edge cache node and missing HSTS.
recommendations: Patch OpenSSL and standardize base images for edge nodes
Enable HSTS with preload-ready settings after validating subdomains
Document cardholder data flow and reduce scope via tokenization

title: Security Posture Baseline — HQ Office
summary: Collected baseline for endpoints, AD, and core services. Primary gaps were legacy printer drivers and inconsistent local admin controls.
recommendations: Remove legacy drivers; isolate print services and apply point-and-print hardening
Deploy LAPS and enforce least privilege for IT support
Standardize endpoint encryption and verify recovery key escrow

title: SAST + Dependency Review — Claims Microservices
summary: Reviewed SAST findings and dependency alerts across 14 services. Confirmed SSRF risk in PDF rendering service and several outdated libraries.
recommendations: Fix SSRF by allowlisting outbound destinations and disabling metadata IP access
Upgrade Spring/Log4j dependencies; enforce Renovate/Dependabot policies
Add egress controls in Kubernetes namespaces for sensitive workloads

title: Physical-to-Network Walkthrough — Depot and Control Room
summary: Onsite walkthrough identified unsecured network jacks in depot offices and shared badge access to control room. No tamper seals on racks.
recommendations: Disable unused switch ports and enforce 802.1X for wired access
Implement unique badge assignments and quarterly access reviews
Add rack locks and tamper-evident seals; document visitor procedures

title: Incident Retrospective — Credential Stuffing Wave
summary: Analyzed April credential-stuffing activity. Primary drivers were weak rate limits and reused passwords; mitigations reduced traffic 78%.
recommendations: Deploy bot management and adaptive challenges on login endpoints
Add breached-password checks and encourage passkeys for end users
Improve detection with login anomaly alerts and geo-velocity rules
